cluster.name: A — preflight requirement vs dispatch-only kit workflow

finding-clusters.cluster: Kit release-preflight.yml at the pin is workflow_dispatch-only, so REQ-SAG-0132 / sprint acceptance row 'Release preflight workflow green' / deliverable 3 cannot be met as written. Required: planned doc amendment, not code. - docs/requirements.md REQ-SAG-0132: reword to require the consumer-owned 'sc-publish dry-run' workflow green on every PR (install dry-run drift check, manifest validation, version lockstep, consumer preflight, cargo publish --dry-run, maturin build), and state that the kit's Release Preflight is dispatch-only and is run by the publisher at release time. Keep the REQ id. Do not change any other requirement. - sprint doc deliverable 3 and acceptance row for REQ-SAG-0132: same rewording; cite the green run on PR #17 (GitHub Actions run 42339767937, check 'sc-publish dry-run / dry-run') as the exercised evidence. - docs/development/sc-publish.md already explains this; make sure wording matches the amended REQ.

In docs/plans/phase-a/sprint-a-9-sc-publish-install.md: - adrs: add ADR-SAG-0011 and ADR-SAG-0022. - requirements: add REQ-SAG-0802 and NFR-SAG-0002. - owned_paths: add scripts/sc-publish-dry-run.sh, .github/workflows/sc-publish-dry-run.yml, crates/sc-jev-py/Cargo.toml, crates/sc-jev-py/pyproject.toml. - Deliverables: one short paragraph recording the consumer-owned dry-run gate decision and the sc-jev-py PyPI-only decision (publish = false, static version required by the kit). - Required validation block: replace the hard-coded /tmp/sc-agent-wheels with SC_AGENT_WHEEL_DIR (or call scripts/sc-publish-dry-run.sh) so the doc matches the implementation. - frontmatter status: set to in-review (QA will set complete at merge).

cluster.name: C — CI determinism and workflow hardening

finding-clusters.cluster: .github/workflows/sc-publish-dry-run.yml and scripts/sc-publish-dry-run.sh (sc-agent-owned; kit workflows are NOT to be touched): - Pin every third-party action to a full commit SHA with a trailing `# vX.Y.Z` comment (actions/checkout, actions/setup-python, actions/cache, dtolnay/rust-toolchain). Resolve SHAs with `gh api repos///git/ref/tags/` (dereference annotated tags to the commit). - runs-on: ubuntu-24.04 (not ubuntu-latest). Keep toolchain 1.94.1 and python 3.11 explicit. - Pin maturin exactly (maturin==, pick the latest 1.x on PyPI today) in the workflow pip install. - Cache: include the toolchain version in the key and add restore-keys; or switch to Swatinem/rust-cache pinned by SHA. - Per-step timeout-minutes on the clone/bootstrap, cargo publish --dry-run, and maturin steps; in the script wrap git clone/fetch in `timeout` with a step-named failure message, and set CARGO_HTTP_TIMEOUT / CARGO_NET_RETRY and pip --timeout explicitly. No retry loops.

scripts/sc-publish-dry-run.sh: - Default wheel dir to `mktemp -d` with a trap cleanup when SC_AGENT_WHEEL_DIR is unset; when it is set, refuse to rm -rf unless the path is non-empty, not '/', not the repo root, and its basename is 'sc-agent-wheels' or the dir is empty/nonexistent. - After checking out the pinned kit revision run `git -C "$kit_dir" reset --hard --quiet && git -C "$kit_dir" clean -fdxq` so a reused .sc-publish-kit cannot carry local edits. - Parse release/sc-publish-pin.toml with `python3 -c 'import tomllib...'` instead of sed; validate repository is a non-empty https URL and revision is 40 hex.

All seven publishable crates (sc-agent-types, sc-agent-secrets, sc-jev, sc-jev-backends, sc-jev-check, sc-treesitter, sc-ai) plus sc-jev-py metadata: - Add a short per-crate README.md (3-10 lines: what it is, which workspace it belongs to, link to repo docs) and `readme = "README.md"`; add `keywords` (<=5) and `categories` (valid crates.io slugs; command-line-utilities for sc-ai and sc-treesitter, parsing for sc-treesitter, development-tools for the libraries) — put shared values in [workspace.package] where common. - Add an explicit `include` allowlist per crate (Cargo.toml, README.md, LICENSE, src/**, plus sc-treesitter assets/queries/** and any build.rs). Add a LICENSE file per crate (copy the workspace MIT text; add a root LICENSE if none exists). - sc-agent-types [[test]] jev_cross_impl escapes the crate root and is silently dropped from the package: keep the test running from the workspace but stop the cargo publish warning — simplest is to move the test entry so it is excluded from the package (the include allowlist already drops it; verify the warning disappears) and add a one-line comment explaining it is workspace-only. - Hoist `toml`, `ureq`, and the sc-observability* pins into [workspace.dependencies] and reference them with `.workspace = true`; unify toml on one major (prefer the newer major already used by sc-jev; adjust sc-jev-check call sites if the API differs and keep tests green). - crates/sc-jev-py/pyproject.toml: add readme, authors, project.urls (Homepage, Repository), and classifiers; keep the static version with the existing comment about the kit's sync check. - cargo publish --dry-run --locked must still pass for all seven crates with zero warnings after these changes; Cargo.lock may change only via the workspace-dependency hoist.

cluster.name: F — closed by documentation (architectural change deferred to Phase A review)

finding-clusters.cluster: Both findings explicitly allow closure by documenting the deliberate choice. Do NOT change dependency pins or feature gating in this sprint; the parent is taking the alternative (caret ranges in library crates; feature-gating mimalloc behind a bin feature) to the Phase A architectural review. - RBP-F001: next to every `=`-pinned sc-observability* dependency (sc-agent-types, sc-ai, sc-jev-py) add a one-line comment stating the pin is deliberate lockstep with the sc-observability release train and is revisited at phase review; in sc-treesitter/Cargo.toml add the same style comment for the `=` pins on mimalloc and tree-sitter*. Add a short "Dependency pinning policy" subsection to docs/development/sc-publish.md stating the current policy and that caret relaxation for library crates is under review. - RBP-F005: add a comment on the mimalloc dependency in sc-treesitter noting it is unconditional for the library target by current choice (cost accepted; feature-gating under review), remove the redundant explicit [[bin]] stanza ONLY if the binary name and path are the auto-detected defaults (src/main.rs → bin sc-treesitter); otherwise keep it. Document `cargo install sc-treesitter --locked` in docs/development/sc-publish.md.
